question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No.1.**
solution:
The correct answer is **'process'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us look into the meaning of the given options - 
 
 
• **aspect - **a particular part or feature of something.
 
• **process - **a series of actions or steps taken in order to achieve a particular end.
 
• **tool - **a device or implement, especially one held in the hand, used to carry out a particular function.
 
• **mechanism - **a system of parts working together in a machine; a piece of machinery.
 
 
 
• From the line with the blank, we can infer that the blank 1 needs a word that would describe the procedure of tree plantation. 
 
• Hence, **process **is the most appropriate option for blank 1. 
 
• So, **option 2 **is the correct answer. 

**Correct paragraph__ - ***Tree plantation is the **(1)__process__** of transplanting saplings or seeds to maximise the amount of greenery and focus on promoting **(2)__afforestation__**. Planting trees can be a very rewarding and fruitful **(3)__endeavour__**! Not only is it **(4)__ecologically__** beneficial for this planet, but it also contributes to helping create an environmentally friendly place to live, as trees help reduce pollutant **(5)__concentration__**.*
